description: Centralize sizing/spacing/text tokens in the three shared primitives so every screen inherits uniform polish. Normalize the Icon size scale, add a spacing scale + shared text/pill roles, and harden GradientButton (never-wrap label + optional small size) and Stepper (height that lines up with buttons). This is the foundation FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on; it is style/token only, no runtime behavior changes. Independent of FEAT-002/003 in content but MUST run first since they rely on these tokens/props.
steps: src/theme.ts: add `export const space = { xs: 4, sm: 8, md: 12, lg: 16, xl: 20 };` below the `radius` export. Do not modify existing colors/gradients/radius/shadow/STATUS_STYLE values (they are the single source of truth).

src/components/Icon.tsx: change the SIZE map from { xs:12, sm:15, md:18, lg:22, xl:28 } to { xs:14, sm:16, md:20, lg:24, xl:30 } so header/tab/inline emoji icons read evenly. Keep lineHeight = fontSize + 2 and the allowFontScaling={false} / accessibility props. No call-site edits are needed because every usage passes a size key.

src/components/ui.tsx (styles StyleSheet at bottom): add shared text roles `body: { fontSize: 14, color: colors.dark }`, `bodyStrong: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '700', color: colors.dark }`, `price: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '800', color: colors.primaryDark }`, and hoist chip styles `pill: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, paddingHorizontal: 14, paddingVertical: 8, borderRadius: radius.pill, backgroundColor: '#fff', borderWidth: 1.5, borderColor: colors.border }`, `pillActive: { backgroundColor: colors.primary, borderColor: colors.primary }`, `pillText: { fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '700', color: colors.dark }`. Do NOT remove or rename any existing style key.

src/components/ui.tsx (GradientButton): add `numberOfLines={1}` and `adjustsFontSizeToFit minimumFontScale={0.85}` to the inner `<Text style={[styles.gradText, textStyle]}>` so long bilingual labels never wrap. Add an optional `size?: 'sm'` prop to the component signature; when `size === 'sm'` merge a new `styles.gradBtnSm: { minHeight: 44, paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 10 }` into the LinearGradient style (default stays styles.gradBtn minHeight 48). Keep pill radius, warmGradient, loading ActivityIndicator and all accessibility props unchanged.

src/components/ui.tsx (Stepper + styles.stepper): set the stepper container to `minHeight: 44` and change its `borderWidth` from 2 to 1.5 (match Field/pill borders) while keeping the 34x34 step buttons (styles.stepBtn) and `stepQty` minWidth 34. This makes a Stepper placed beside a button align to the same ~44-48px height band. Keep onMinus/onPlus/qty props and hitSlop unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` (after `npm install`) exits 0 with no errors.
src/theme.ts exports `space`; existing color/radius/gradient/STATUS_STYLE values are byte-for-byte unchanged.
Icon.tsx SIZE map is 14/16/20/24/30 and no call site passes a size that now conflicts (all call sites use size keys).
GradientButton accepts an optional `size` prop (default unchanged) and its label has numberOfLines={1}; existing call sites still compile without passing `size`.
Stepper container minHeight is 44 with borderWidth 1.5; step buttons remain 34x34; all existing Stepper usages compile unchanged.
